Sub:- Format of reports to be extracted from Legal Dash Board-reg.

Ref:- This office letter/e-mail no. LC-9(13)2013/ACC Pending

Sir,

Please refer to the above mentioned reference vide which
suggestion for format of reports to be extracted from Legal Dash Board
was to be furnished to this office at the earliest preferably by 02-11-2015.
However, no suggestions received from field offices in this regard till this
date.

Therefore, in this regard, you are once again requested to provide
your valuable suggestions regarding formats or reports/returns to be
developed for extraction from the Legal Dash Board. Your suggestion in
this matter may please be furnished by at the earliest preferably by 20-
11-2015 positively.

Yours’ faithfully,
